title: Vitamin D–BMI coupling adds no established predictive benefit for PTH beyond flexible conventional measures across two NHANES cycles
abstract: A vitaminD × BMI product did not establish improved logPTH prediction beyond flexible conventional biomarkers in exploratory NHANES2003–2004 to2005–2006 transfer (3,772 source; 3,781 target adults): weighted MSE difference -0.0000001202 log(pg/mL)², jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.00026033,0.00049464].
